THE GAP

Warangal’s civic problems are visible, but not accountable

Potholes, drainage overflow, and water supply issues go untracked
Reporting is slow and unclear
No transparency, accountability, or feedback loop
THE SOLUTION

One simple place to report, route, and resolve

FixWarangal turns a citizen’s observation into a trackable work item for the right authority.

THE PRODUCT

Everything a civic issue needs to move forward

THE JOURNEY

From complaint to closure in four visible steps

Every handoff is clear to the citizen and actionable for the authority.

01

Citizen posts

Photo, description, and location create the first reliable record.

02

AI categorizes

The report becomes structured issue data instead of an open-ended complaint.

03

Authority updates

The right team is assigned and the status moves to In Progress.

04

Citizen notified

Resolution is visible, communicated, and ready for public trust.
